projects.title: Customer ETL Pipeline
projects.bodyText:
- Implemented an **ETL Pipeline** that extracted 250,000 records of ecommerce customer data from **MySQL**
 -  Transformed data in **PySpark** through filtering out 5,000 rows containing null values, engineering a purchases feature, and loaded it to **Google BigQuery**
 - Engineered a **logistic regression model** to predict customer retainment, achieving an accuracy rate of 75%

projects.title: GPT Lyric Generator
projects.bodyText:
- Utilized **GPT-2 embeddings** and the **GPT-Neo** model from Hugging Face to implement a full-stack website that randomly generates lyrics in the same style as Taylor Swift and deployed it onto **Heroku**
 - Deployed the model with a loss of 0.138 to Hugging Face and fine-tuned the output of API calls by adjusting hyperparameters, resulting in a 20% increase in cohesive and accurate lyrics

projects.title: LSTM Trading Model
projects.bodyText:
- Implemented a deep learning model using 4 LSTM layers in **Keras** and stock data through **REST API** calls to Alpaca to analyze stock data for a 100 tickers from the Q1 in 2022 until present
 - Predicted the next 10-day moving average for each ticker took long/short positions by comparing the forecast to the current 10-day moving average, generating **10% profit** in 1 month

projects.title: Sports Ball Classification Model
projects.bodyText:
- Fine-tuned a **Google ViT** model in Python that takes prompts the user to upload an image of a sports ball and outputs the probability of which type of sports balls it could be
 - Used **Roboflow** to classify images and create the train, test, and validation datasets, and deployed the fine-tuned model to Hugging Face
 - Implemented a full-stack website using Flask, HTML, and CSS to allow users to interact with the model

projects.title: TCP Chat App
projects.bodyText:
- Engineered a chat application using **Boost** libraries in C++, facilitating seamless multi-client connectivity to a server through **TCP/IP** networking protocols to ensure efficient and reliable message delivery
 - Implemented efficient **threading** and **synchronization** mechanisms to handle multiple clients simultaneously, enhancing the overall system stability and user experience
